title: lta_convert
description: This program converts between different linear transform formats.

in_mni.description: Input transform of MNI / XFM type
in_mni.title: Input MNI Transform

in_reg.description: Input transform of TK REG type (deprecated format)
in_reg.title: Input REG Transform

in_niftyreg.description: Input transform of NiftyReg type (inverse RAS2RAS)
in_niftyreg.title: Input NiftyReg Transform

in_vox.description: Input transform in source image space (inverse VOX2VOX)
in_vox.title: Input VOX Transform

out_reg.description: Output transform in REG DAT format
out_reg.title: Output REG Transform

out_niftyreg.description: Output transform in NiftyReg format (inverse RAS2RAS)
out_niftyreg.title: Output NiftyReg Transform

out_itk.description: Output transform in ITK TXT format (inverse LPS2LPS)
out_itk.title: Output ITK Transform

out_vox.description: Output transform in source image space (inverse VOX2VOX)
out_vox.title: Output VOX Transform

src_geometry.description: Specify src image geometry (mov volume for TKREG/register.dat)
src_geometry.title: Source Geometry Image

subject_name.description: Specify subject name (overrides if input has subject name defined)
subject_name.title: Subject Name
